The Ministry of Home Affairs has released the IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026 on its official website, mha.gov.in, for candidates who appeared in all stages of the Assistant Central Intelligence Officer (ACIO) Grade-II/Tech recruitment process. The Intelligence Bureau invited technically qualified graduate candidates with valid GATE 2023, 2024 or 2025 scores for the IB ACIO Tech Recruitment. The interview round for shortlisted candidates was conducted from 9th March to 1st April 2026.The final merit list has been prepared based on candidates’ GATE scores, Skill Test or performance in the Interview round. Candidates whose roll numbers are listed in the result PDF have been provisionally selected for appointment under the IB ACIO Tech. Through the exam, a total of 258 vacancies will be recruited for ACIO Tech II posts.

IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026 Out

The IB ACIO Final Result has been released at the official website on 18th May 2026. Candidates who have cleared the Skill Test/Interview round can check their result at mha.gov.in. Roll numbers of selected candidates are provisionally selected for the Medical Examination process and other joining formalities.

IB ACIO Final Result 2026: Overview

The final result for IB ACIO Tech has been announced for GATE qualified candidates willing to sit for Assistant Central Intelligence Officer. Candidates can check the important highlights related to the recruitment process, result date, vacancies and selection stages in the table below.

Particulars Details
Organization Name Intelligence Bureau (IB)
Conducting Authority Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)
Exam Name IB ACIO Tech-II Exam 2026
Total Vacancies 258
IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026 18th May 2026
IB ACIO Skill Test/Interview Exam Date 9th March to 1st April 2026
Selection Process GATE qualified marks, Skill Test, Interview, Document Verification, Medical Examination
Official Website mha.gov.in

IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026 PDF

The Ministry of Home Affairs has released the IB ACIO Tech Final Result in PDF format at mha.gov.in. The result PDF contains the roll numbers of candidates who have qualified for the Medical Examination. Candidates can download the PDF and use the Ctrl+F option to quickly search for their roll number in the list of shortlisted candidates.

Direct Link to Download IB ACIO Final Result 2026

Steps to Download the IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026

Candidates can view the IB ACIO Merit List via the Ministry of Home Affairs website. The following steps can be followed by candidates to view the IB ACIO Tech-II/Executive Final Result 2026.

  • Log onto the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs using the link – www.mha.gov.in.
  • Navigate to the “What’s New” or “Results” tab available on the home page.
  • Search for the link related to “IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026”.
  • Click on the result PDF link.
  • Download the PDF file on your device.
  • Use the CTRL+F shortcut to search your roll number.
  • If your roll number appears in the list, you are provisionally selected for the post.

What are the Details Mentioned on IB ACIO Tech Final Result?

Some of the information that will be available on the IB ACIO Tech Final Merit List PDF are mentioned below. Candidates must check all the information while checking the final result.

  • Name of the conducting authority
  • Examination name
  • Post name
  • Roll numbers of selected candidates
  • Category details
  • Result declaration date
  • Instructions for document verification
  • Further joining guidelines

How is the IB ACIO Tech Final Merit List 2026 Prepared?

The IB ACIO Tech Final Merit List is prepared based on candidates’ performance in the GATE examination and the Interview round conducted by the Intelligence Bureau. Candidates with valid GATE 2023, 2024 or 2025 scores were shortlisted for the interview process. The final selection is made after evaluating candidates’ overall performance in both stages.

IB ACIO Final Result 2026: Category-wise Selection Details

The final result for IB ACIO Tech 2026 includes category-wise selection details for both Electronics & Communication (EC) and Computer Science & IT (CS) streams. A total of 258 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted through the final merit list released by the Ministry of Home Affairs. The table below shows the number of selected candidates across different reservation categories and technical disciplines.

Category Electronics & Communication (EC) Computer Science & IT (CS) Total
Unreserved (UR) 74 40 114
EWS 14 7 21
OBC 44 24 68
SC 24 13 37
ST 12 6 18
Grand Total 168 90 258

What’s Next After IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026?

Those candidates whose roll numbers have been published in the IB ACIO Final Merit List can now proceed to the final phase of the selection process. The formalities required to be completed before joining as ACIO Grade II/ Tech Officers shall include certain formalities to be completed by the Intelligence Bureau and Ministry of Home Affairs.

  • Medical Examination
  • Character and Antecedent Verification
  • Issuance of Final Appointment Letter
  • Training and Joining Formalities

What are the Documents Required After IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026?

Those who make it to the list of selected candidates in the IB ACIO-II/Tech Final Result need to go through a few more post-selection formalities before final selection.

  • Educational Qualification Certificates & Mark Sheets
  • Valid GATE Scorecard (2023/2024/2025)
  • Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Voter ID/Passport)
  • Date of Birth Certificate
  • Category Certificate, if any
  • EWS/PwD Certificate, if any
  • Domicile Certificate
  • Passport Size Photographs
  • Interview Call Letter
  • Medical Examination Reports
  • Antecedent Verification Documents
  • Documents for Final Appointment and Joining (Ministry of Home Affairs)

FAQs on IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026

Q1. Is the IB ACIO Tech Final Result 2026 announced?

The IB ACIO Final Result 2026 has been announced on 18th May 2026 in the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Q2. Where can I check IB ACIO Final Result 2026?

Candidates can check their result from the official website of MHA at mha.gov.in by using the link to result PDF.

Q3. What will be next after IB ACIO Final Result 2026?

Candidates selected will be summoned for the process of undergoing a medical test, character verification, etc.

Q4. What is included in IB ACIO-II/Tech Final Result PDF?

The result PDF includes details such as roll numbers of selected candidates, name of examination, name of post, date of result, etc.

Q5. Is there any selection stage after IB ACIO Tier 3 Result?

All the selected candidates who have cleared IB ACIO Tier 3 will go for Document Verification & Medical Examination.
